StudyOS V62 — Universal Portable Build

This HTML is generated from the same modular StudyOS source used by the web/PWA build.
It is not a reduced or separate application. All pages, modals, feature modules, Quran data, styles and fonts are included.

Android: download StudyOS-V62-Dedicated-Mushaf.html and open it with Chrome or Samsung Internet.
Desktop: open the same file directly, or use the web build for installable/offline PWA behavior.
